statutes.title: Theft
statutes.description: Whoever intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of the possession of any person without that person's consent, moves that property in order to such taking, is said to commit theft.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment of up to 3 years, or fine, or both.

statutes.title: Theft in Dwelling House or Building
statutes.description: Theft committed in any building, tent or vessel used as a human dwelling or for custody of property.
statutes.penalty: Imprisonment of up to 7 years and fine.

statutes.title: Punishment for Murder
statutes.description: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine.

statutes.title: Divorce Proceedings and Grounds
statutes.description: Grounds for dissolution of marriage by decree of divorce including cruelty, desertion, adultery, and mutual consent.

statutes.title: Punishment for Cruelty to Child
statutes.description: Whoever having the actual charge of or control over a child, assaults, abandons, abuses, exposes or wilfully neglects the child.
